tables.createHint: Starts with two columns (title, published). Use "Edit schema" later to customise.
tables.intro: A Table is a section of your site (News, Products, Team…). Each table has columns (fields) and rows (records).
tables.emptyDescription: Tables are the sections your site shows: News, Products, Team members — anything. Create your first one to get started.
tables.confirmDeleteTable: Delete this table and all its rows?
tables.editorTip: Edit schema sets up columns (fields). + Add row adds a record.
tables.rowsEmptyDescription: Add the first record — title, content, image and so on, based on your columns.
tables.rowFormMultilingualHint: Multilingual fields show hy / ru / en tabs — fill each language separately.

columnEditor.title: Edit table schema
columnEditor.intro: Define fields for each record. Key is a technical id used by the API (a–z, 0–9, _); Label is what editors see; Type picks the input (text, number, image, etc.).
columnEditor.noColumns: No columns. Add the first one.
columnEditor.label: Label
columnEditor.hiddenHint: Stored but not shown in the table
columnEditor.errorBadKey: Bad key "{{key}}" — use letters, digits and underscore, starting with a letter
